name: Startup Dope

sources.title: Submit News — early-stage startup coverage form and 'new Submission Center'

requirements: Early-stage startup or product seeking editorial coverage — it's a news site, not a directory
Keep the pitch short: 'Tell us a Little (We really mean it, please keep it short) about you and your Startup'
A newer 'Submission Center' flow is offered as the preferred experience ('Submit your Product (New Flow)')
preparation: A short pitch: who you are and what the startup does — brevity is explicitly demanded
Availability for follow-up: 'We'll reach out to you to get more details'
For press releases instead: email sales@startupdope.com (likely paid newswire route)
workflow: Use the embedded form or the newer 'Submission Center' link ('Submit Now')
Provide a brief description of you and your startup
Editorial team reviews and reaches out for more details if interested
Coverage publishes as a news/interview article on startupdope.com
watchFor: Two parallel flows exist — the legacy form and a newer Submission Center; use the newer one
Press-release publishing goes through sales@startupdope.com and is likely a paid product — don't conflate it with the free editorial form
Site monetizes with side services (directory-submission services, ads setup, content writing) — expect upsell pitches
No submission fee is stated for the news form, but coverage is not guaranteed
countsAsLive: A news article or interview about the startup published on startupdope.com
unknowns: Whether the Submission Center requires an account
Editorial response time and acceptance rate
Whether a paid option exists inside the Submission Center
